name: lock_rate_by_seed
caption: Degenerate count per seed as k/n. Domain overall is 20 trajectories; domain seed-hit is how many of the ten domain seeds have at least one degenerate replicate. n=2 CIs are not reported as if they were uncertainty.
alt_text: Degenerate count per seed as k/n. Domain overall is 20 trajectories; domain seed-hit is how many of the ten domain seeds have at least one degenerate replicate. n=2 CIs are not reported as if they were uncertainty.
limitations: n=2 per seed. A 2/2 cell is a count, not CI [1, 1].
